summary: Second fixing chat of the Kiln Build Preflight test audit (whole PRD). New tests raise AC-PREFLIGHT-01 and AC-PREFLIGHT-03 from Weak to Adequate, and fresh re-graders confirmed both (15 of 15 and 18 of 18 stated parts). Every criterion in force is now Adequate or better and test-audit.md reads Done. One new test found a real defect: a Start on the Folder missing page from the existing branch that ended a pause kept the pause's request, so the run paused again at once and the preflight never ran. A one-line engine fix now clears the whole pause, as Start does; deliverable-review found no High or Medium issue, and the changelog records it. Each new test was seen to fail with its behavior broken, and npm run verify passes. Because implementation changed, a fresh delivery audit is due.
